name: Trader windows - prepared manual reward fixture

steps._note: Prepare a completed trader quest in the disposable test save with seven configured selectable reward choices. Open its reward window normally before running. Visually check screen fit, centered reward quality, equal Choose One/Select font, purple hover, and all seven choices. Click an owned toolbelt item to check details, then reselect the desired reward and claim normally. Job-card hover and Accept checks require the job-list screen separately.
